title: Genesis 4:8 — "And Cain said to Abel his brother"
summary: Genesis 4:8 in English, now rendered "And Cain said to Abel his brother" with the word "said" highlighted; when they were in the field Cain rose up against Abel and killed him.

text.text: 8 And Cain said to Abel his brother; and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother and killed him.
